_status: PROTOTYPE DRAFT - NEEDS CLINICIAN REVIEW. Built from ACEP 'Is it an emergency?' warning signs plus the injury-specific checks in PLAN.md. Burn items and the pairing of items to injury types are the author's draft, not clinical guidance. Not a validated triage tool.
_rules: One question per item: no 'or'/'and' joining two separate signs. Any 'yes' or 'not_sure' answer means emergency (decided in router.js, never by Gemini).

items.breathing: Is the person having trouble breathing?
items.passed_out: Did the person pass out, even for a moment?
items.head_hit: Did the person hit their head?
items.bad_headache: Does the person have a severe headache?
items.bleeding: Is there bleeding that will not stop with firm pressure?
items.bone_out: Is a bone sticking out through the skin?
items.deformed: Does the injured part look bent the wrong way?
items.numb: Is the skin below the injury numb?
items.cold: Is the skin below the injury cold?
items.blue: Is the skin below the injury blue?
items.cant_move: Is the part below the injury unable to move?
items.thinners: Does the person take blood thinners?
items.burn_large: Is the burn bigger than the person's palm?
items.burn_face: Is the burn on the face?
items.burn_hands: Is the burn on the hands?
items.burn_genitals: Is the burn on the genitals?
items.burn_numb: Does the burned spot feel numb?
items.burn_chemical: Was the burn caused by a chemical?
items.burn_electric: Was the burn caused by electricity?
items.smoke: Did the person breathe in smoke?
items.bladder: Has the person lost control of their bladder?
items.bowel: Has the person lost control of their bowels?
items.chest_pain: Does the person have chest pain?
items.cant_stand: Is the child unable to stand?

ambulance._note: ACEP 'when to call an ambulance' questions. Yes or not sure to any: headline becomes 'Call 911'.

questions.could_worsen: Could it become life-threatening on the way?
questions.moving_harm: Could moving the person cause more injury?
questions.paramedic: Does the person need care that only paramedics can give?
questions.too_far: Would getting to the ER by car take too long?
